sources.title: The Death and Life of Great American Cities
sources.author: Jane Jacobs
sources.usage: Background design method for mixed primary uses, fine-grained permeability, varied building stock, active street interfaces, incremental change, and everyday diversity.
sources.limitations: Method and design rationale only; does not establish site facts, Beijing statutory thresholds, official controls, or author endorsement of this proposal.

sources.title: Sustainability and Cities: Overcoming Automobile Dependence
sources.author: Peter Newman and Jeffrey Kenworthy
sources.usage: Background design method for transit-oriented urban structure, walking and public-transport accessibility, and assessment of automobile dependence.
sources.limitations: Method and comparative background only; local mode share, station catchments, energy use, and thresholds require official or cleared Beijing data. Peter Newman is not Oscar Newman.

sources.title: Cities for People
sources.author: Jan Gehl
sources.usage: Background design method for human-scale public-space observation, protection, comfort, enjoyment, active edges, walking, cycling, and staying activities.
sources.limitations: Observation framework only; does not supply local public-life counts, universal numerical standards, statutory accessibility findings, or author endorsement.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap data via Overpass API
sources.retrieval_status: partial_snapshot_acquired_2026-08-17; mobility_and_buildings_processed; rendered_as_low_contrast_background_proxy_v1.0; street-aligned concept fields are presentation-only; poi_invalid_after_http_429; green_water_not_downloaded; not_integrated_as_submission_existing_conditions
sources.intended_format: Overpass JSON with clipped GeoJSON derivatives
sources.usage: A partial, reproducible background snapshot is retained outside the submission package for streets, walking and cycling links, crossings, barriers and buildings. The mobility/building derivatives are rendered only as low-contrast explanatory context in the v1.0 bilingual PNG figures in a WGS84 display frame; the research cache may use EPSG:4548 for separate metric experiments, but that projected analysis is not embedded in the figures. Street-aligned M/A/P concept fields are visual discussion aids only and are absent from formal GeoJSON and metrics. Raw data remain outside the submission package. They are not a full existing-condition network or a basis for submitted numeric targets.
sources.limitations: The 2026-08-17 mobility raw snapshot has SHA-256 2b6579850c51f6e6cd0c4a7b58d12d1fb85ac556f1b877608049a0e8ceb1f88d and the buildings raw snapshot has SHA-256 8e33759f1489e10f934e3ce17da66cd4d0c03c01189c9b2c44b9d4b0491ad5c4. The POI request produced an empty file after HTTP 429 responses and green/water is unavailable, so activity-mix and blue-green proxy values remain unknown. Crowdsourced completeness, relation/way duplication and tagging vary; derived data must retain ODbL attribution and applicable share-alike obligations. The static figure background is contextual texture only and cannot establish official boundaries, road redlines, ownership, legal public access, statutory controls, actual public-life activity or field-observed comfort.

sources.title: Beijing public-data transport catalog: bus stops and passenger guidance
sources.publisher: Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport via Beijing Public Data Open Platform
sources.intended_format: CSV, XLSX or keyed JSON API when authorized
sources.usage: Candidate official cross-check for bus route and stop names, rail interchange and passenger-guidance information supporting low-car access analysis.
sources.limitations: Do not commit API keys, cookies or account data. Confirm fields, coordinates, CRS, update date, license and redistribution permission after download; catalog visibility alone does not make the records submission-ready GIS.

sources.title: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
sources.usage: Candidate cross-check for tree cover, grass, built-up land and surface water around the provisional study extent.
sources.limitations: The 2021 10 m product is too coarse for street furniture, actual shade quality, small ground-floor interfaces or statutory green and water control lines.

sources.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A imagery
sources.intended_format: STAC or OData metadata and 10/20/60 m imagery
sources.usage: Candidate seasonal cross-check for vegetation, surface water and broad land-cover change, paired with WorldCover rather than used alone.
sources.limitations: Cloud, shadow, acquisition date and seasonal effects must be recorded. Imagery cannot prove actual public life, accessibility, legal status, precise road or building geometry, or engineering conditions.

sources.title: Beijing official park directory and Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park page
sources.publisher: Beijing Municipal Forestry and Parks Bureau
sources.usage: Candidate official cross-check for park name, type, address, opening and management facts after manual verification.
sources.limitations: HTML and PDF are not GIS datasets and do not grant permission to copy page maps or images. Matching to OSM geometry remains an inference and must not be labelled an official park boundary.

sources.title: Qinghuayuan Railway Station historic site
sources.usage: Candidate official reference for heritage facts and conservative design screening around the Qinghuayuan Station historic site.
sources.limitations: No verified reusable Shapefile or GeoJSON protection boundary is supplied. Do not digitize a webpage illustration and present it as an official heritage control line.

sources.title: Haidian District 2025 statistical communiqué
sources.usage: Candidate district-scale context for population, employment, industry, science and public-service narratives.
sources.limitations: District aggregates cannot be downscaled to the three key areas, converted into a fabricated local heat map or used as site-level demand evidence.
